title: 'Jaws' territory is now a great white nursery with 18 young sharks found

Understanding these sharks replaces fear with a better appreciation of their ecosystem role.

This innovative process significantly reduces the time needed to produce custom dental prosthetics. His efforts are expanding, promising more "mirror moments" for grateful patients.

title: Nvidia CEO joins the list of CEOs who disagree with Bill Gates warning on AI

This perspective contrasts with warnings from figures like Bill Gates.

America's Gulf allies are urging the White House to de-escalate the conflict.

title: US-Iran war flares up again: How far can Tehran go in retaliation?

title: Travis Kelce’s $1.5M nonprofit faces scrutiny over management spending
content: Travis Kelce’s Eighty-Seven and Running Foundation is facing scrutiny over its reported spending between 2021 and 2024. The nonprofit raised $1.5 million and spent about $1.1 million, with $469,000 listed for management and $446,000 for charity. Kelce’s business manager Aaron Eanes disputed the figures, saying some charitable operational costs were misclassified. He said management fees dropped to zero in 2025 as the foundation works to improve transparency and governance.

title: Muslim cleric's 'women should stay home' remark draws Kerala CM's ire

title: Kalyan Silks’ Rs 1,500 Onam ad misleading; consumer court orders Rs 31,500 payout

The commission found the prominent claim misleading, ignoring fine print conditions. It also awarded Rs 25,000 compensation and Rs 5,000 litigation costs. The retailer must also provide durable invoices and clear future promotions.

title: Congo's Ebola death toll crosses 3,000 amid worst outbreak in country's history

Schools have reopened amid concerns about potential transmission within classrooms.  No approved vaccine exists for the Bundibugyo species, though some are in development.  Britain has pledged over fifty million pounds to support outbreak containment efforts.

title: Two injured in explosion at railway station in Germany’s Augsburg
content:
The station has been completely shut down and rail services suspended (File photo)

Two people sustained minor injuries after an unidentified object exploded at a train station in the southern German city of Augsburg, local media reported. Window panes were also damaged in the explosion, which occurred in a passageway inside the station. Police responded to the incident at around 5 am local time and cordoned off parts of the station as officers investigated the scene. An explosive-disposal robot was also deployed. The station was later completely shut down and rail services were suspended after police described the object as “suspicious”, without providing further details. Earlier, one track had remained operational. Augsburg is a regional transport hub located around 55 km (35 miles) west of Munich, Germany’s third-largest city after capital Berlin and Hamburg.

End of Article

title: 10 feared dead as Turkish cargo ship sinks after collision with tanker off Istanbul
content: a cargo ship carrying 10 crew members collided with a tanker in the marmara sea off Istanbul . search-and-rescue teams were deployed to locate the crew members following the collision . the cargo ship collides with the Turkish-flagged tanker Alsu about 20 miles (32 km) south of Silivri .

title: Watch: ‘Unsafe’ Rajasthan govt school building demolished after CJP campaign
content: a dilapidated government school building in Rajasthan's Rampura (Kanwarpura) village was demolished by authorities on Wednesday . visuals show the old building being brought down by a bulldozer in the presence of officials from the district administration and education department . a toi community guidelines school had already been declared unsafe .

title: 'He can remove Pakistan from world picture': Shinde on PM Modi's cropped SCO photo
content: deputy chief minister criticises shehbaz Sharif's office for cropping pm out of SCO family photograph . he said if Modi Ji wants, he can remove Pakistan from world picture . the original photograph showed heads of member states standing together .

title: In overnight change, US releases new form for Green Card sponsor
content: the form I-864 is the 'Affidavit of Support' filed by those sponsoring family members for a green card . from august 31, only the new version will be accepted for filings submitted on or after this date .

title: Two Turkish ships collide off Istanbul; one believed sunk, 10 crew missing
content: the chemical tanker Alsu collided with the bulk carrier Tugberk Imamoglu . one ship believed to have sunk and its 10 crew members missing . the ship failed to respond to repeated calls and its crew could not be reached .
